แบ่งเป็น Primary BM dz และ Secondary to systemic disease

sub.html:
• Metastatic Solid tumor
  • Autoimmune: SLE, Sjogren syndrome
  • Nutritional & toxin: B12 deficiency, Folic deficiency, Alcohol — megaloblastic anemia, hypersegmented neutro (ลูกศรจากวงเล็บ B12 / Folic deficiency)
  • Infection: Overwhelming sepsis, Mycobacteria, Brucellosis, Ehrlichiosis
  • Other: Storage dz (Gaucher, Niemann-Pick), Sarcoidosis, Hypersplenism
